# Historical development summaries (August–September 2026)

**This directory is closed. Do not add files here — and do not edit this notice to
permit it.** The rule is [`CLAUDE.md`](../../CLAUDE.md)'s ("Where documentation
goes"), not this file's. Deleting the line above does not reopen the directory; it
only hides the rule from the next reader. If the policy should genuinely change,
change it in `CLAUDE.md` and record why in [`docs/record/`](../record/).

It holds **eight** dated development summaries written between 2026-08-16 and
2026-09-10 — retrospective narratives with PR links, in a format no longer used.
They are kept as-is because converting them would be churn for no reader benefit.
Eight is the final count.

## Where this kind of writing goes instead

- **What happened**, what was decided, and which predictions were wrong →
  [`docs/record/`](../record/), one file per month. A dated narrative of recent work
  belongs there, as an appended section — not as a new file here, and not as a
  rewritten header at the top of the month's file.
- **Traps that cost an hour** → [`landmines.md`](../project/landmines.md).
- **Pending work** → [`deferred-work-backlog.md`](../project/deferred-work-backlog.md).
- **The cold-start handoff** → [`next-steps.md`](../project/next-steps.md), pointers
  only, under a hard 8 KB ceiling.

The four documents have four jobs, and `CLAUDE.md` explains why mixing them is
what broke the handoff and the backlog within a week of each other.
